components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on a tool surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#fff; color:#000; border:0; border-radius:4px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; font:500 12px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),scale 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#E4E4E7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale:.96; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions that remain visually quiet.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:#A1A1AA; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius:4px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; font:500 12px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: Compact dashboard entry for one utility.
components.html: JSON FormatterFormat and validate JSON data
components.css: .ds-tool-card { display:flex; gap:12px; padding:16px; color:#fff; background:#111113; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius:4px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-tool-card:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-tool-card strong,.ds-tool-card small { display:block; } .ds-tool-card strong { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-tool-card small { color:#71717A; font-size:12px; margin-top:4px; } .ds-icon-tile { display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; border-radius:4px; color:#A1A1AA; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); } .ds-icon-tile svg { width:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text or URL entry field.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; color:#fff; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius:6px; font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.12); }

narrative.overview: Marczelloo Tools should feel like a focused native workspace: precise, compact, and immediately operational. The interface stays visually quiet so uploaded files, settings, progress, and output remain the most prominent information on every screen. The identity is intentionally monochrome and dark-first.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black canvas with closely stepped zinc surfaces.
Square, low-radius geometry and fine translucent borders.
Bold sans-serif headings paired with mono labels for data and controls.
One distinctive outline icon per tool on a consistent 24px grid.
Fast, restrained interaction feedback with no ornamental motion.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color never decorates the shell. Reserve it for status, validation, or the user's generated visual output.

rules.name: The Mono-With-A-Job Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for code, data, identifiers, formats, and measurements.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Add a structural border first. Use a shadow only when a surface truly sits above another surface.

dos: Do preserve the monochrome shell and reserve semantic color for feedback.
Do use the shared tool-icon registry instead of defining icon maps per page.
Do render outline icons with currentColor and a consistent 1.5px stroke.
Do keep labels short, operational, and specific to the action.
Do test the brand mark and tool glyphs at 16px as well as 32px.
donts: Don't use emoji or Unicode symbols as interface icons.
Don't assign the same glyph to different tools merely because they share a category.
Don't introduce gradients, accent colors, or soft rounded cards into the application shell.
Don't use filled icons for inactive states or mix icon libraries on one surface.
Don't place the project mark directly on a white surface without a dark boundary or clear space.
